name: Linksys Max-Stream MR7350 AX1800 Dual-Band Wi-Fi 6 Router
description: Linksys Max-Stream MR7350 AX1800 dual-band Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) router — up to 574 Mbps on 2.4 GHz and 1201 Mbps on 5 GHz (1.8 Gbps combined), with 2x2 MU-MIMO and OFDMA, rated for homes up to 1,700 sq ft and 25+ devices. It runs a 1.2 GHz quad-core processor with 512 MB of memory and back panel has 4x Gigabit LAN ports, 1x Gigabit WAN port, and a USB 3.0 port for network storage (USB works in parent mode only). Set up and manage everything from the Linksys app over Bluetooth; it supports WPA2/WPA3 and Intelligent Mesh, so it can join a Velop mesh or be paired with a second unit to extend coverage. Two adjustable, non-detachable antennas (215 × 155 × 56 mm, 567 g). In good condition. The photos are the manufacturer's official product images for this model — message me and I'll send photos of the actual unit before you commit.
